question.hi: Prove karo ki agar ek line triangle ki do sides ko proportional divide karti hai, to woh third side ke parallel hai (BPT).
question.en: Prove that if a line divides two sides of a triangle proportionally, it is parallel to the third side (BPT).

answer.hi:
Given: ΔABC mein D on AB, E on AC, aur AD/DB=AE/EC
To Prove: DE || BC

Proof (by contradiction):
Maano DE, BC ke parallel nahi hai. To ek doosri line DE' draw karo jo BC ke parallel ho, E' on AC.
BPT se: AD/DB=AE'/E'C
Diya gaya hai: AD/DB=AE/EC
Isliye AE/EC=AE'/E'C, jiska matlab E aur E' same point hain.
Isliye DE hi BC ke parallel hai. Hence Proved.
answer.en:
Given: In ΔABC, D on AB, E on AC, and AD/DB=AE/EC
To Prove: DE || BC

Proof (by contradiction):
Suppose DE is not parallel to BC. Draw another line DE' parallel to BC, with E' on AC.
By BPT: AD/DB=AE'/E'C
Given: AD/DB=AE/EC
So AE/EC=AE'/E'C, meaning E and E' are the same point.
Hence DE itself is parallel to BC. Hence Proved.

question.hi: ΔABC~ΔPQR, perimeter(ABC)=36cm, perimeter(PQR)=24cm. Agar PQ=10cm, AB nikaalo.
question.en: ΔABC~ΔPQR, perimeter(ABC)=36cm, perimeter(PQR)=24cm. If PQ=10cm, find AB.

answer.hi:
Similar triangles mein perimeter ratio = side ratio
Perimeter ratio = 36/24 = 3/2
AB/PQ = 3/2
AB/10 = 3/2
AB = 15cm
answer.en:
In similar triangles, perimeter ratio = side ratio
Perimeter ratio = 36/24 = 3/2
AB/PQ = 3/2
AB/10 = 3/2
AB = 15cm

question.hi: Ek 6m ka pole zameen pe 4m ki shadow banata hai. Usi waqt ek building ki shadow 24m hai. Building ki height nikaalo (similar triangles use karke).
question.en: A 6m pole casts a 4m shadow. At the same time, a building casts a 24m shadow. Find the building's height using similar triangles.

answer.hi:
Pole aur building dono sun ke same angle pe shadow banate hain, isliye similar triangles bante hain.
Pole height/Pole shadow = Building height/Building shadow
6/4 = h/24
h = 6×24/4 = 36m
answer.en:
The pole and building cast shadows at the same sun angle, forming similar triangles.
Pole height/Pole shadow = Building height/Building shadow
6/4 = h/24
h = 6×24/4 = 36m

question.hi: Prove karo Pythagoras Theorem: right triangle mein hypotenuse² = base² + perpendicular².
question.en: Prove the Pythagoras Theorem: in a right triangle, hypotenuse² = base² + perpendicular².

answer.hi:
Given: Right ΔABC, ∠B=90°
To Prove: AC²=AB²+BC²
Construction: BD⊥AC

Proof:
ΔADB~ΔABC (AA: ∠A common, ∠ADB=∠ABC=90°)
→ AB²=AD×AC ...(1)

ΔBDC~ΔABC (AA: ∠C common, ∠BDC=∠ABC=90°)
→ BC²=DC×AC ...(2)

(1)+(2): AB²+BC²=AC(AD+DC)=AC×AC=AC²
Hence Proved.
answer.en:
Given: Right ΔABC, ∠B=90°
To Prove: AC²=AB²+BC²
Construction: BD⊥AC

Proof:
ΔADB~ΔABC (AA: ∠A common, ∠ADB=∠ABC=90°)
→ AB²=AD×AC ...(1)

ΔBDC~ΔABC (AA: ∠C common, ∠BDC=∠ABC=90°)
→ BC²=DC×AC ...(2)

Add (1)+(2): AB²+BC²=AC(AD+DC)=AC×AC=AC²
Hence Proved.

question.hi: Do khambe (poles) 6m aur 11m lambe hain, unke base ke beech ki distance 12m hai. Poles ke tops ke beech ki distance nikaalo.
question.en: Two poles of height 6m and 11m stand 12m apart. Find the distance between their tops.

answer.hi:
Height difference = 11−6 = 5m (vertical leg)
Horizontal distance = 12m
Distance between tops² = 5² + 12² = 25+144 = 169
Distance = √169 = 13m
